info.title: IDPGitOps — F-004 Secret and token lifecycle
info.description: Client contract. This feature serves nothing; it calls Azure Key Vault through one client [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/akvwriter/akvwriter.go:81] and two SaaS token endpoints through the shared transport seam [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/cmd/saas-token-rotator/minters.go:20]. Vendor payloads are named, not redefined. Shapes are $ref'd from schemas.json.

putSecret.note: One write path; strategy decides soft-delete behaviour.

getSecret.note: Returns the projection modelled as akv_secret_version.

disableOldVersions.note: Post-rotation cleanup; failures are logged, not fatal.
